data.text:
Thank you so much, Mr. JoJo, for sharing this. 🙏🔥 
I am deeply honored to stand as one of the Fierce Five strong women united in purpose and to serve our GCV community with heart, integrity, and unwavering commitment.
 
At the center of this movement is our beloved founder, Ms. Doris Yin, represented by the lotus. 🌸
She rises from the depths of adversity with elegance, wisdom, and divine strength. Her calm leadership anchors us all and reminds us that clarity, purpose, and purity of heart can move nations.

Right beside her, I rise as the phoenix forged in fire, reborn through trials, and called to lead with fearless truth and unstoppable momentum. 🔥
Because in GCV, we do not fear the fire we rise through it. Our hearts burn for truth, for freedom, and for a future worthy of all humanity. ❤️🔥

Alongside us stands dear Ms. Nonny Padja, our vice chair, symbolised by the eagle. 🦅 She sees what others cannot. Her fierce clarity and strategic wings guide us through storms and into strength. 

Atty. Ebru of Turkey embodies the Lion. 🦁
Bold, just, and uncompromising, she roars for truth and defends it without hesitation. Her leadership in Europe and across the globe is both a shield for the voiceless and a sword of justice, fearlessly cutting through lies and oppression to uphold what is right.

From East Africa, Ms. Herine Makosewe moves with the power of the tiger. 🐅 Graceful yet fierce, focused yet deeply grounded in service, she uplifts her people with fearless determination and a heart anchored in impact. 

🌍 But the Fierce Five are not alone.
We are the spark, but all of you, the global sisterhood, are the wildfire of change.

From Ms. Rung Arun Maneechot in Thailand, Ms. Hong Xuaner in China, Ms. Thi Bich Van Nguyen and Ms. Lành Thị Nguyễn,  in Vietnam, to the extraordinary women of Indonesia Ms. Elshe Afriani, Ms. Lien Marlina, Ms. Bel, Ms. Maria, and all the hardworking GCV Ambassadors  you are not just building regions, you are building revolutions.

In the Philippines, I stand in deep reverence for these phenomenal women:
Dr. MD Adonnah, Mrs. Lerma Ablan, Ms. Marivic Temblador, Ms. Frelyn Sajor, Ms. Nor Omar, Ms. Jennifer Botalon, Mrs. Esperanza Samson, Mrs. Grecilda Fajardo, Ms. Lalyn, Ms. Klouj, Dr. Maria Teresa Dela Cruz, Ms. Mirasol Flores, Ms. Virgie Castillo, Ms. Demi, Mrs. Emelinda Fernandez, Ms. Flor Balacano, Ms. Diesebel, Ms. BSM Matura, Ms. Annabel Borja, Ms. Irish, and Ms. Melany, your strength, consistency, and commitment to our cause are always appreciated. 

To our African sisters across East, West, North, and South your leadership is bold, brilliant, and deeply necessary. Special thanks to Ms. Herine Makosewe and every woman ambassador lifting communities and driving real change on the ground.

To our resilient women of Turkey, led by Atty. Ebru, your courage commands respect. You stand with unwavering conviction, defending truth with grace, strength, and clarity. Your leadership radiates far beyond your borders, and we stand with you in deep respect and solidarity. 

✨ Shout out to:
Ms. Samah Mousa, thank you for your daily commitment and reposts. Thank you for showing up every single day.

Also, shout out to Ms. Christina Tanguay of Canada. Every time you post or comment, your words uplift  and your presence empowers. Thank you from the heart. 🙏🔥

This movement is not just led by women. 
It is transformed by their courage, strengthened by their compassion, and inspired by their vision.

And it stands firm because of the unwavering commitment of both women and men.

Side by side, we rise united in purpose, equal in mission, and unstoppable as one GCV family.

Together, we are building a legacy rooted in truth, freedom, and the power of collective leadership.

And like the lotus, phoenix, eagle, lion, and tiger, we each rise in our unique strength. But we do not rise alone.

We rise together. Fierce. Focused. Unafraid.

💫 To every woman across the world:
If you feel the stirring in your heart, listen to it.
If you feel the call to lead, step into it.
This is your moment. We need you. The world needs you.

Let’s rise together and shape the GCV legacy that will echo across generations.

We are not just leading.

We are transforming.

With purpose and the spirit of the 🔥 Phoenix,
Lumari ✍️
Executive Director & Committee Chair
Global GCV Core Team

To all our beloved GCV Ambassadors in the Philippines 🇵🇭 

Maraming salamat. 🙏

This 3.5 million GCV data milestone it’s because of you.

Because you showed up, even when it was hard. 
We've been at this for almost two years now and yet the fire in your hearts is still burning bright. 🔥

That fire is the fuel of this movement.
From the first days of the campaign until now, people have come and gone. And to each one thank you so much. You are part of this journey. You are part of our history. And you will always be part of our success.
 
From the deepest part of my heart thank you.
 
Let’s build forward. Let’s build stronger. Let’s build together. 
 
Lumari 🕊️ | Executive Director – GCV Core Team
